title: Virtual Card Management: Tracking Virtual Card Purchases by Department
summary: Explains how to manage Virtual Card spending by department: create/confirm team group structure (up to 30 groups), apply custom card nicknames (including department codes/project IDs), enable real-time spending alerts routed to departmental approvers, and run/export departmental reports filtered by team group and nickname for budget reconciliation/variance analysis.
faqs: How do I set up or confirm my department structure for virtual cards?
What naming (nickname) should I use on virtual cards to track transactions by vendor/project/campaign?
Can I monitor virtual card purchases in real time, and can alerts be sent to the right approvers?
How do I generate a departmental report filtered by team group and card nickname?
How many department groups can I maintain in this setup?
How do I export departmental summaries for budget reconciliation and variance analysis?
